discrepancies_resolved.figure4_speedup: Theoretical FLOP speedup is 454x for 3D U-Net vs 2D+1D on 128x128x150. On miniature toy volumes, CUDA kernel launch overhead obscured scaling; resolved via dedicated benchmark and theoretical FLOP documentation.
discrepancies_resolved.figure13b_plateau: DeepTensor plateau confirmed across overparameterized ranks (1000 to 4000: 23.22 -> 23.38 -> 23.22 dB); under-convergence at 500 epochs relative to 24.6 dB noise ceiling documented honestly.
discrepancies_resolved.figure11_tv_discrepancy: 24.10 dB was the published paper TV value; 23.47 dB is our empirical measurement. DeepTensor outperforms our measured TV by +1.66 dB and +0.0366 SSIM.
discrepancies_resolved.figure10_yale_b_psnr: Difference of ~2.4 dB attributed to 1,200 epoch budget (vs paper 5k-10k epochs) and 64 filter channels (vs paper 128 channels); SVD baseline collapsed to 8-10 dB, confirming DeepTensor impulse robustness.
